changes: Hold CUE and press UP or DOWN in the arrangement editor to select rows.
FUNC + REC and FUNC + PLAY copy and clear the selected rows; FUNC + STOP replaces the selected rows, or the cursor row, with the copied rows; CUE + FUNC + STOP inserts them.
Paste copied rows into another arrangement after ARR CHANGE.
Without a selection, every key works as on stock.
